_lisez_moi: Description of Outerplane: its raw characters (heads converted into a donor PMX by outils/tete/outerplane.py, bibliotheque.py extraire --outerplane).

compatibilite._lisez_moi: What the tool does with this game's models, according to the code and the data of 15/11/2026. Read by python3 -I outils/jeux; COMPATIBILITE.md is drawn from it. No other tool reads it.
compatibilite.resume: The heads are converted and stored in the face library, but Chimera offers none of them today.
compatibilite.provenance: An extraction of the game files by a third-party tool, laid out in the format of our extraction tool: one folder per character with `controle.glb` (mesh, bones, morphs), `rendu.json` (materials and textures) and the textures. No tool in this repository produces this format.

personnages.contenu: one folder per character (`<id>` or `<id>_<Name>`) with `controle.glb`, `rendu.json` and the textures named by `rendu.json`

tetes.detail: Converted into a donor PMX (outils/tete/outerplane.py), then measured like a ZZZ head: 60 heads stored out of 78 on 15/11/2026, 14 rejected (eyeball welded to the skin, eyebrows without geometry), 4 left out. Not in Chimera's catalogue: running them through Chimera has never been tried. 16 heads do not close their eyes (blink at 30-93 %).

coiffures.detail: 44 hairstyles measured in the face library, but not offered: Chimera only takes the hairstyles of a character whose outfit is cut.

vetements.detail: The donor PMX contains only the head: cutting the outfits has never been done on these models.

expressions.detail: The EYE_* and MOUTH_* morphs are renamed to MMD names ("morphes_mmd") during the conversion; the others keep their names. In the donor PMX only.

etapes: Put the character folders in `personnages` (or write its path under `jeux.outerplane.personnages`). Check: `python3 -I outils/jeux` counts the folders that have `controle.glb` and `rendu.json`.

Heads: the ZZZ pipeline must have produced the pivot head (`<donnees>/tete-pivot`), then `<python> -I outils/tete/bibliotheque.py extraire --outerplane --sortie <donnees>/bibliotheque-visage`; a single head as a trial: `<python> -I outils/tete/outerplane.py convertir <character folder> <output.pmx>`.
limites: Cannot be the active game (`jeux.actif`): its description has neither a base head nor a list of models. Its heads go through the pivot head of the active game (ZZZ).
The "materiaux" table (FACE, FACE_EYE, HAIR, BODY) assumes this game's M_<id>_… material names; cutting the face into eyes, mouth and eyebrows is done by geometry and failed on 14 heads.

_exclus: heads left out of the spectrum (METHODE.md, "Outerplane (06/11)"): not playable characters with a human face, or duplicates

exclus.2000034: covered face (left out of the spectrum)

_materiaux: Outerplane material names in the common language (outils/jeux/README.md), first matching pattern wins. A game GLB has four useful materials, M_<id>_FACE, _FACE_EYE, _HAIR…, _BODY… (M_<id>_ prefix optional, case-insensitive). FACE is not only the skin: outils/tete/outerplane.py then cuts it by geometry into 颜, 目, 目光, 二重, 齿, 口舌, 颜2, 飾り; FACE_EYE (eyelashes and eyebrows mixed) into 眉 and 睫. BODY: clothed one-piece body, like 体 in ZZZ. Read by outerplane.py (role of each primitive) and by atlas/pmx.lire for a PMX stored in its source folders (there are none today).
_morphes_mmd: MMD names of the Outerplane morphs (after the typos are normalized); the others keep their names (EYE_SHY, MOUTH_PAIN...), in the eye or mouth panel
